guard: restore infrastructure can update only an exact subset of the streams it may create and inspect
why: The restore path needs one STREAM.UPDATE for the freshly-created records KV hardening step.
Giving every restored or excluded stream UPDATE would let the maintenance phase rewrite data-plane
configuration. The exact-subset guard and the emitted grant list are both independently mutated.

mutations.name: every infrastructure stream receives UPDATE instead of only the named subset
mutations.expectRed: a non-update stream gets no UPDATE grant
mutations.cell: a non-update stream gets no UPDATE grant

mutations.name: the exact records UPDATE grant is omitted
mutations.expectRed: the named update stream gets exactly one UPDATE grant
mutations.cell: the named update stream gets exactly one UPDATE grant

mutations.name: an UPDATE outside create/info scope is accepted
mutations.find:
for (const stream of updateStreams)
    if (!streams.includes(stream)) throw new Error(`infrastructure update stream ${stream} is outside its create/info scope`);
mutations.expectRed: an update stream outside create/info scope is rejected
mutations.cell: an update stream outside create/info scope is rejected
